question.worked_solution:
First, let's swap the left and right-hand sides so that the variable is on the left-hand side:

$$
-\frac{2a}{5}=-4
$$

Now, we multiply both sides of the equation by the reciprocal of $-\frac{2}{5},$ which is 

$$
{(-\frac{2}{5})}^{-1}=-\frac{5}{2}.
$$

 This gives:

$$
\begin{aligned}-\frac{2a}{5} & =-4 \\ -\frac{5}{2}\cdot (-\frac{2a}{5}) & =-\frac{5}{2}\cdot (-4) \\ 1a & =\frac{20}{2} \\ a & =10\end{aligned}
$$
